verdicts.reason: A is essentially a uniform shrink of the original, centred with a wide dead margin on the left and right. The orphaned 'live' is still there, and the body copy and FRI 7:30 PM are getting small, but nothing collides and the hierarchy holds. B makes the headline big, but the right half falls apart: the date card overlaps the headphone graphic, the body copy sits on the grey circle, the RSVP button is jammed against it, and the 'LISTENING SESSION' label is shrunk to an illegible line under the card.
